font.source: Debian/Ubuntu fonts-inter package, exact installed version recorded by verification
font.fallback: system sans-serif; fallback is not typography parity

primitives.input: native HTML input in reference; GTK Entry in implementation

parity_status: experimental; native scenarios and reference comparisons must pass before declaring conformance
deliberate_differences: GTK native accessibility, IME and clipboard
destructive button darkened for text contrast
native focus ring does not depend on browser selectors
input and outline borders strengthened to at least 3:1 contrast
Table uses GTK ColumnView headers, resizable columns and native row selection
Table rows are virtualized; stable keys retain selection across reorder; visual/motion parity remains unqualified
List and key/value groups use GTK ListView with stable keyed selection and virtualized rows; item actions/media are not supported
List and key/value reference geometry, physical input and motion remain unqualified
Scroll regions use GTK native vertical scrollbars and bounded natural heights; horizontal scrollbars and Radix motion are not implemented
Sections use native heading/group accessibility semantics; browser layout and full visual parity are not qualified

Tabs and split panes use native GTK Notebook/Paned interaction; stable keys retain local tab choice and divider movement stays local. Physical keyboard/pointer and reference visual/motion parity remain unqualified.
Choices and toggles use native GTK DropDown/CheckButton with typed local events and focus-preserved values; Radix popup/checkbox appearance and motion are not qualified.
